shell_commands: /bin/zsh -lc 'git status -sb; git branch --show-current; cat .lore/test-commands.yml; cat src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts; cat specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md; cat package.json'

/bin/zsh -lc "cat scripts/lore-list-tests.mjs; cat src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts | head -115; rg 'specs/.*#[0-9]' src/orchestration -n | head; rg -n 'inputSchema|interface ToolDefinition' src/types/ai.ts; cat CHANGELOG.md | head -35; ls scripts/spec-links"
/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n 'specs/.*#[0-9]|@spec' src scripts | head -35; cat jest.config.js; cat tsconfig.json | head -55"

/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
p='src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts'
s=open(p).read().replace(\"import type {ToolDefinition}\",\"import {Ajv, type ValidateFunction} from 'ajv';\\nimport type {ToolDefinition}\")
s=s.replace('  execute: ToolExecutor;\\n}\\n\\nexport class ToolRegistry', '  execute: ToolExecutor;\\n  validator?: ValidateFunction;\\n}\\n\\nexport class ToolRegistry')
s=s.replace('  private readonly tools = new Map<string, StoredTool>();','  private readonly tools = new Map<string, StoredTool>();\\n  private readonly ajv = new Ajv({strict: false, validateFormats: false});')
s=s.replace('    this.tools.set(resolved.name, {definitionSource: definition, execute});','    let validator: ValidateFunction | undefined;\\n    if (typeof definition "'!== '"\\'function\\') {\\n      try {\\n        validator = this.ajv.compile(resolved.inputSchema);\\n      } catch (error) {\\n        throw new Error("'`Invalid input schema for tool ${resolved.name}`, {cause: error});'"\\n      }\\n    }\\n    this.tools.set(resolved.name, {definitionSource: definition, execute, validator});')
open(p,'w').write(s)
p='scripts/lore-list-tests.mjs';s=open(p).read().replace('    file,\\n  }));','    file,\\n    ...(assertion.fullName.match(/specs\\\\/["'^'"\\\\s]+#\\\\d+/)?.[0] && {\\n      spec: assertion.fullName.match(/specs\\\\/["'^'"\\\\s]+#\\\\d+/)[0],\\n    }),\\n  }));');open(p,'w').write(s)
p='.lore/dod.md';s=open(p).read().replace('- [ ] Add "'`ajv` to `dependencies` in `package.json` and `package-lock.json` (`strict: false`, `validateFormats: false`, no coercion, no defaults, no injected `additionalProperties: false`) and bump the package version `MINOR`.'"','- [x] Add "'`ajv` to `dependencies` in `package.json` and `package-lock.json` (`strict: false`, `validateFormats: false`, no coercion, no defaults, no injected `additionalProperties: false`) and bump the package version `MINOR`.'"').replace('- [ ] Compile static "'`ToolDefinition.inputSchema` at `ToolRegistry.register` time (throwing an error naming the tool on invalid schemas) and cache compiled validators for function-valued `ToolDefinitionSource` schemas by schema object reference (`WeakMap`).'"','- [x] Compile static "'`ToolDefinition.inputSchema` at `ToolRegistry.register` time, throwing an error naming the tool on invalid schemas.'"\\n- [ ] Cache compiled validators for function-valued "'`ToolDefinitionSource` schemas by schema object reference (`WeakMap`).'"');open(p,'w').write(s)
p='CHANGELOG.md';s=open(p).read().replace('## [Unreleased]','## [Unreleased]\\n\\n### Changed\\n\\n- Invalid static tool input schemas now fail during registration with the tool name.');open(p,'w').write(s)
PY
npm version minor --no-git-tag-version --ignore-scripts
timeout 300 npm test -- --runInBand --runTestsByPath src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts"

/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts scripts/lore-list-tests.mjs specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md .lore/dod.md CHANGELOG.md package.json package-lock.json'
/bin/zsh -lc 'git diff --stat; git diff -- src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts scripts/lore-list-tests.mjs; git status -sb'

/bin/zsh -lc "git add .lore/dod.md CHANGELOG.md package.json package-lock.json scripts/lore-list-tests.mjs specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts && git commit -m 'Compile static tool schemas at registration' && git push origin HEAD && git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main --no-edit && git push origin HEAD && git status -sb"
